2608.07346.title: An End-to-End Agent Auditing Engine
2608.07346.paper_summary: With the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs), harnesses have become essential infrastructure for deploying agents across a wide range of domains. The fast-evolving harness ecosystem has also made rigorous capability evaluation increasingly important. However, efficiently building an end-to-end, systematic, and comprehensive evaluation pipeline remains a significant challenge. To address this challenge, we introduce $A^2E$ (Agent Auditing Engine), an end-to-end evaluation engine designed for agent harnesses. $A^2E$ leverages our newly proposed Agent Task Protocol (ATP) to enable the rapid integration of evaluation tasks with different harnesses. Through an automatically instrumented Monitor, it captures and generates standardized execution traces during experiments. In the Evaluation stage, $A^2E$ systematically assesses harness capabilities using a suite of multidimensional metrics. Compared with correctness alone, these metrics provide a more fine-grained characterization of differences among harnesses in execution efficiency, tool use, task planning, and error recovery. Experiments conducted with $A^2E$ further reveal that model-harness combinations exhibit substantial performance variation across different types of tasks, and that no single combination consistently outperforms all others across every task. These findings not only demonstrate the necessity of systematic evaluation but also provide useful guidance for the co-evolving of models and harnesses. Our code is available at https://github.com/datamllab/A2E.
2608.07346.paper_summary_zh: 隨著大型語言模型（LLMs）的快速發展，代理的基礎設施已成為在各個領域部署代理的必要條件。快速演變的基礎設施生態系統也使得嚴格的能力評估變得越來越重要。然而，有效地構建一個端到端的系統化和全面的評估管道仍然是一個重大挑戰。為了解決這一挑戰，我們介紹了 $A^2E$（代理審核引擎），這是一個專為代理基礎設施設計的端到端評估引擎。$A^2E$ 利用我們新提出的代理任務協議（ATP）來實現不同基礎設施的評估任務的快速整合。通過自動化儀表化的監控器，它在實驗過程中捕獲並生成標準化的執行痕跡。在評估階段，$A^2E$ 使用一套多維度指標系統地評估基礎設施的能力。與僅僅考慮正確性相比，這些指標提供了對基礎設施在執行效率、工具使用、任務規劃和錯誤恢復等方面差異的更細緻的描述。使用 $A^2E$ 進行的實驗進一步揭示了模型-基礎設施組合在不同類型任務中表現出顯著的性能變化，並且沒有任何單一組合在每個任務中始終優於其他組合。這些發現不僅證明了系統評估的必要性，還為模型和基礎設施的共同演進提供了有用的指導。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/datamllab/A2E 獲得。
